data.title: AEON Biopharma Outlines ABP-450 Biosimilar Plan, Targets Q4 2026 IND
data.description:
AEON Biopharma outlined its plan to develop ABP-450 as a potential biosimilar to BOTOX®, with a CMAP study IND submission planned for Q4 2026.

Key Highlights:

  • AEON is pursuing a 351(k) biosimilar pathway and targeting full-label access across BOTOX®’s 12 therapeutic indications.
  • FDA feedback indicated previously completed comparative studies may be submitted as supportive evidence with appropriate scientific bridging.
  • The proposed CMAP pharmacodynamic study is designed to compare ABP-450 and BOTOX®; study initiation is expected in Q1 2027.
  • ABP-450 has not been FDA-approved for any therapeutic indication; its safety and effectiveness for therapeutic use have not been established.

Original SEC Filing: AEON Biopharma, Inc. [ AEON ] - 8-K - Oct. 23, 2026

data.title: US to introduce label for all American-made seafood
data.description:
Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. said on Friday the United States would introduce a label for all American-made seafood to help inform people's choice about where the goods come from.

  • Kennedy made the announcement at a political rally with President Donald Trump in Fort Myers, Florida

  • The "U.S. Caught Seafood" label proposed by the Food and Drug Administration would be voluntary, the White House said in a statement

  • The Trump administration also launched a new website Seafood.gov for US fishermen and consumers about federal seafood initiatives, the White House said

data.title: U.S. Natural Gas Futures Fall on Mild Near-Term Weather — Market Talk
data.description: U.S. natural gas futures extend the week's losses as mild weather for the time of year combines with rising production. "That recovery is bringing supply back into the market just as domestic consumption moves through a milder stretch," Gelber & Associates says in a note. Thursday's storage report that reduced the inventory surplus over the five-year average by 10 Bcf to 35 Bcf was enough to generate a brief recovery, "but it has not changed the broader picture of adequate supply heading into November," the firm adds. "Colder conditions later in the outlook should increase residential and commercial consumption into November, but the intervening mild period gives recovering production more time to replenish inventories." Nymex natural gas settles down 5.6% at $2.64/mmBtu. (anthony.harrup@wsj.com)

data.title: Buy NextEra Energy Stock to Tap Into Power Demand, Says Analyst. Plus, Bending Spoons and 3 More. — Barrons.com
data.description:
NextEra Energy — NEE-NYSE Buy — $80 on Oct. 21 by Melius Research Leverage to significant growth in Florida and numerous other states and a best-in-class power-generation development business in Energy Resources make NextEra a high-quality way to invest in the significant increase in power demand under way in the U.S. Against the data-center hub targets laid out at the 2025 investor conference — 15 gigawatts of new generation for large load by 2035 with a 30 gigawatts upside case — the company's origination channels should comfortably meet and beat both. The diversified mix of natural gas, nuclear, and renewables provides numerous solutions to drive and sustain significant earnings, cash flow, and dividend growth well into the next decade.

In addition, NextEra is absorbing Dominion Energy in an all-stock deal that creates one of the largest energy companies in the U.S. by enterprise value. Power demand is entering its steepest growth cycle in a generation, inflected upward by the artificial-intelligence data-center buildout, electrification, and reshoring. NextEra is structuring itself to be the only company with the balance sheet, supply chain, and operating platform to meet that demand at scale. Target price: $100.

Lithia Motors — LAD-NYSE Buy — $299.53 on Oct. 21 by Seaport Research Partners Lithia Motors reported third-quarter 2026 adjusted earnings per share of $10.34, which compares to our/consensus forecasts of $9.88/$9.70, respectively (although note that roughly three weeks ago, consensus was $10.09). The print was clean, the result of solid all-around performance, particularly in certain areas such as used-vehicle gross profit per unit and selling, general, and administrative expenses as a percentage of gross profit. A low tax rate helped by 18 cents per share, but even adjusting for that, adjusted EPS would have been a strong $10.16.

The other positive driver versus our forecast was a low share count, which helped by 22 cents per share. There were some puts and takes in the quarter, with revenue ahead and gross margins slightly light (although much better than feared), but SG&A was well controlled and relatively stable on a sequential basis. Target price: $490.

Bending Spoons — BSP-Nasdaq Buy — $45.55 on Oct. 21 by StoneX Equity Research While investors will naturally focus on revenue, adjusted operating income, organic growth, and forward guidance, we believe that individual quarterly variations are less determinative of Bending Spoons' long-term thesis than they would be for a traditional SaaS/software company....

Quarterly execution matters, but compounding matters more. We believe that investors should focus on whether Bending Spoons can consistently compound revenue, cash flow, acquisition capacity, and intrinsic value per share over many years rather than allowing the noise of any single quarter to dominate the investment debate....

We reiterate our Buy rating and $50 price target on Bending Spoons ahead of third-quarter 2026 results.

Super Micro Computer — SMCI-Nasdaq Buy — $32.49 on Oct. 21 by Needham Super Micro Computer provided preliminary fiscal first-quarter 2027 results that call for revenue to come in above the high end of its prior guidance. Revenue in the fiscal first quarter is now expected to be $19 billion at the midpoint versus $15 billion previously. The increased revenue outlook is driven by increased demand for AI platforms.

Additionally, Super Micro now expects GAAP and non-GAAP gross margin to be 12.0% to 12.5%, above its prior guide of 10.4% to 10.8%. The better-than-expected GM is attributed to favorable customer and product mix. We continue to expect Super Micro's backlog strength to continue following record levels of more than $60 billion reported last quarter. This momentum is expected to be driven by the ramp of next-generation AI systems.

Our target price remains $46, based on about a seven times price/earnings multiple of our new calendar-year 2028 non-GAAP EPS estimate.

Snowflake — SNOW-NYSE Outperform — $319.61 on Oct. 21 by Evercore ISI Snowflake has pulled back with the broader AI trade over the past week, and we think that's understandable given that Snowflake shares have basically tracked the VanEck Semiconductor exchange-traded fund over the past year (+46% year to date vs. +52% for the ETF).

However, after catching up with Snowflake's CEO recently and a series of discussions with customers and partners, including at Snowflake's recent New York City user conference, we come away from those events feeling good about the beat/raise path for Snowflake heading into the second half, and ultimately into fiscal 2028. At about 14 times enterprise value/calendar-year 2027 sales, we believe the valuation remains attractive for a business pushing toward 40%-plus product growth with steady margin expansion....

When looking ahead to calendar 2027 (fiscal 2028), compares will get tougher starting in the fiscal second quarter, but Street estimates have the potential to move higher....

The bottom line is there's a very practical beat/raise path ahead of Snowflake, and the recent pullback creates an attractive entry point for longer-term investors. Target price: $430.

data.title: PERMIAN BASIN ROYALTY TRUST ANNOUNCES RECORD DATE AND MEETING DATE FOR SPECIAL MEETING TO CONSIDER SOFTVEST PROPOSALS
data.description:
DALLAS, Oct. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Argent Trust Company, as trustee ("Trustee") of the Permian Basin Royalty Trust () ("Permian" or the "Trust"), today announced that it has received a request from SoftVest Advisors, LLC ("SoftVest"), together with other holders of units of beneficial interest ("Units") who collectively with SoftVest own more than 15% of the outstanding Units of the Trust, to call a special meeting ("Special Meeting") of the Trust's Unit holders to be held on November 23, 2026, with a record date of October 13 , 2026. The purpose of the Special Meeting requested by the Unit holders is to present for a vote by the Trust's Unit holders (i) a proposal to approve and adopt the terms of an amendment to the Trust Indenture to effect the Business Combination pursuant to the Combination Agreement (as set forth in the proxy statement / prospectus included in the Form S-4 filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission by PBT Land and Minerals, Inc. ("New PBT"), SoftVest, SoftVest, L.P., SoftVest GP I, LLC, and Eric L. Oliver (the "Participants") and declared effective on October 23, 2026, (ii) a proposal to approve and adopt the terms of the PBT Land and Minerals, Inc. Omnibus Incentive Plan, and (iii) a proposal to authorize an adjournment of the Special Meeting, if necessary or appropriate, to permit solicitation of additional proxies in favor of the aforementioned proposals. In accordance with the terms of the Trust's Indenture, the Trustee intends to call the Special Meeting. Additional details regarding the Special Meeting will be set forth in the Trustee's notice of special meeting to be mailed to Unit holders beginning on October 23, 2026 and are also set forth in the Form S-4.

Neither the Trust, nor the Trustee is a party to the Combination Agreement, nor is the Trust or the Trustee soliciting proxies or participating in any offering of securities. The Trustee is not making any recommendation to Trust unitholders as to how to vote with respect to the transaction. The Trust is issuing this press release solely for informational purposes for Trust unitholders. Unitholders are encouraged to read the Form S-4 and the Form S-1 filed by New PBT and declared effective on October 23, 2026 in their entirety and other materials filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission by New PBT and SoftVest for additional information.

IMPORTANT ADDITIONAL INFORMATION AND WHERE TO FIND IT

This press release is not a proxy solicitation. None of the Trust, the Trustee, or its officers or directors, are soliciting proxies in connection with any special meeting of Trust unitholders and are not participants in any solicitation of proxies by the Participants and/or other unitholders in connection with any special meeting. The Trust and the Trustee are not making any offering of securities. The Trustee and the Trust are making this communication for informational purposes only and do not intend to file a proxy statement or registration statement with respect to the proposed transaction.

New PBT has filed (i) a registration statement on Form S-4, which includes a proxy statement relating to a meeting of Trust unitholders and a prospectus of New PBT, and (ii) a Form S-1 registering securities of New PBT with respect to a rights offering with the Securities and Exchange Commission. Unitholders and other investors are strongly encouraged to read the Form S-4, including the proxy statement/prospectus, the Form S-1, any amendments to the Form S-4 and/or Form S-1, and any other documents filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission when they become available because they will contain important information. Unitholders may obtain a free copy of any Form S-4, proxy statement/prospectus, Form S-1, and any amendments and documents that New PBT or SoftVest files with the SEC from the SEC's website at www.sec.gov.

FORWARD-LOOKING STATEMENTS

Any statements in this press release about future events or conditions, and other statements containing the words "estimates," "believes," "anticipates," "plans," "expects," "will," "may," "intends," and similar expressions, other than historical facts, constitute forward-looking statements within the meaning of the safe harbor provisions of the Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995. data.title: Delek Logistics Partners, LP Increases Quarterly Cash Distribution to $1.14 per Common Limited Partner Unit
data.description:
Delek Logistics Partners, LP () (“Delek Logistics”) today declared its quarterly cash distribution for the third quarter 2026 of $1.14 per common limited partner unit, or $4.56 per common limited partner unit on an annualized basis. The third quarter 2026 cash distribution is payable on November 10, 2026, to unitholders of record on November 3, 2026.

About Delek Logistics Partners, LP

Delek Logistics is a midstream energy master limited partnership headquartered in Brentwood, Tennessee. Through its owned assets and joint ventures located primarily in and around the Permian Basin, the Delaware Basin and other select areas in the Gulf Coast region, Delek Logistics provides gathering, pipeline, transportation, and other services for its customers in crude oil, intermediates, refined products, natural gas, storage, wholesale marketing, terminalling, water disposal, and recycling.

Delek US Holdings, Inc. () owns the general partner interest as well as a majority limited partner interest in Delek Logistics and is also a significant customer.

data.title: Kinder Morgan 2026: Revenue $4.53B, EPS $0.34— 10-Q Summary
data.description:
Kinder Morgan reported 2026 revenue of $4.53 billion and net income of $764 million, up 9.3% and 21.7%, respectively, from 2025. Diluted EPS rose to $0.34 from $0.28. The company also cited pipeline expansion and higher volumes among its business drivers.

data.title: Jewett-Cameron to Sell Surplus Oregon Property to Washington County for $5.9 Million
data.description:
Jewett-Cameron, through its wholly owned subsidiary JC USA, entered into a purchase and sale agreement to sell its surplus seed property in Hillsboro, Oregon, to Washington County for $5.9 million. The sale is subject to the county's due diligence and approval by its Board of Commissioners, among other conditions; closing is expected after the inspection period. Sale proceeds will first repay any amounts outstanding under the company's credit facility, although none are currently outstanding.

Agreement details:

  • Agreement type: Purchase and Sale Agreement for real property
  • Counterparty: Washington County
  • Signed / Effective: Oct 19 2026 / same
  • Duration / Termination: Closing within 15 days after inspection periods expire, with a possible 15-day extension
  • Reason: Monetize surplus seed property
